interface.longDescription: An outcome-first Agent Skill for product owners using Claude Code or Codex. The owner decides the product outcome, tradeoffs, and protected actions. The agent owns research, technical decisions, implementation, project-required procedures, and proof. SkipHow adds no runtime or intelligence; it makes that boundary explicit and portable.
